note: Extra Grove units delivered by the update feed. Modules carry their driver inline so new hardware support lands without a core rebuild. Unit CO2 and Unit IMU moved into the core catalog in v1.0.0, so the feed no longer shadows them.

modules.name: Unit Accel
modules.source: (ctx) => { const st = { x: 0.01, y: 0.02, z: 1.0, shakes: 0, threshold: 1.6 }; return { state: st, tick(dt) { st.x += (Math.random()-0.5)*dt*0.4; st.y += (Math.random()-0.5)*dt*0.4; st.z = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.1, 1 - st.x*st.x - st.y*st.y)); }, setControl(id) { if (id === 'shake') { st.shakes++; st.x += 1.1; ctx.emit('accel', st); } } }; }

modules.name: Unit Kmeter
modules.source: (ctx) => { const st = { volts: 12.02, amps: 0.42, watts: 5.05, kwh: 0.012 }; return { state: st, tick(dt) { st.watts = st.volts * st.amps; st.kwh += st.watts * dt / 3600000; }, setControl(id, v) { if (id === 'load') st.amps = Number(v); } }; }
